notes.title: Hotfix 3
notes.content:
Back alley Darts have added two new maps to play darts on 

We have Grave Yard Darts and Back Yard Darts.


We will be adding more maps to the game as we do more updates and fix any issues that has been found.

If you find any issues please let us know via [url=https://discord.gg/KqQsCUte2N]Discord[/url]
